verdict.rationale: Vanta's own marketing describes per-framework progress tracking ("track progress all in one place") and "continuous, complete visibility" across the program. It also flags gaps through automated tests, and the API can list tests and documents filtered by framework. None of this explicitly describes a readiness view that combines passing controls, open gaps and remaining work into a single percentage. Missing for 10: documented per-framework readiness percentage, explicit breakdown of passing vs. failing controls and remaining work in one view, independent or hands-on corroboration that the readiness figure is accurate.
